newsitem.title: USA: Pure World, Amer Industrial settle suit.
newsitem.headline: Pure World, Amer Industrial settle suit.

text.p: Pure World Inc said on Tuesday that it and American Industrial Properties REIT have settled litigation arising from Pure World's efforts to influence the management of the trust, and Pure World will report a gain from the settlement.

Pure World said that the settlement agreement provides that the trust pay $825,000 to Pure World to reimburse it for costs incurred in connection with the disputes and as consideration for releases and a standstill agreement.
Pure World said it has also agreed to sell its trust shares to a third party at $2.75 per share, or an aggregate of approximately $2,494,250.
The payment in the settlement and the proceeds of the stock sale will result in a net gain to Pure World of about $1,200,000 in the fourth quarter, the company said.
